title: 50-dps verification of 8we6, qou-2qt2, qou-3cgi, qou-3qla, and qou-6hzr (Casoratian antisymmetry, bar-symmetrization falsifier, C1 slope separation, Bring palindromic cubic discriminant, and co-equational Stokes bridge)

assertions.claim: Two-channel Casoratian W_k is antisymmetric under channel swap, vanishes on proportional rungs, and the three H_4 Route-A c_2 shifts (+12, +13/6, -40) sum to -155/6 != 0
barEvenHalf + barOddHalf reconstructs f(q) identically and barOddHalf(f(q), f(q)) = 0 falsifies any purely bar-even candidate for a non-zero odd channel
thetaHalf(m) = m*(m-1)/2 has first difference m and second difference 1, and C1 slope 1/2 is separated from GGM Stokes slopes {-1, 1} by span 2
Dividing the palindromic colour-cubic sextic by z^3 yields 16w^3 + 24w^2 - 13w + 2 in w = z + 1/z with cubic discriminant -80000 = -2^7 * 5^4, and resurgence audits partition 45 + 28 = 73
When equational ODE Stokes multiplier aEq = 0 (entire EGF at q=1), combinedBridgeResponse reduces to co-equational term aCoeq * gK != 0
